Viña Vik is one of Chile's and South America's most famous wineries and has been recognised as one of the world's finest vineyards. The winery's modern architecture complements the rolling landscape of vineyards.

The itinerary includes a guided winery visit explaining the winemaking process, a tasting of premium VIK wines and lunch at a restaurant overlooking the valley and vineyards.

## Valparaíso and Viña del Mar

The road to the coastal cities of Valparaíso and Viña del Mar passes through olive groves, fruit orchards and vineyards in the Curacaví and Casablanca valleys (120 km from Santiago).

Valparaíso is built across 42 hills, has a distinctive architectural character and is recognised by UNESCO as a cultural heritage site. Different levels of the city are connected by a system of historic lifts and funiculars, stairways and pedestrian paths.

You can visit Sotomayor Square and the naval administration building, which is a national monument. The walk then continues towards Concepción Hill along Gervasoni and Atkinson promenades, with splendid views of the seaport, one of the principal symbols of Valparaíso.

Next, travel to Viña del Mar, known as the 'Garden City', whose shoreline features attractive beaches and imposing cliffs. Its main sights include the Flower Clock, Reñaca Beach, the waterfront promenade and the Fonck Museum.

At the end of the excursion, return to Santiago. The excursion lasts 9 hours, with a stop for lunch (not included in the price).

On this full-day group excursion, we travel from Santiago to Viña del Mar and Valparaíso.

In Viña del Mar, you will visit [Quinta Vergara Amphitheatre](/chile/place/quinta-vergara-amphitheater/), the venue of the International Song Festival. The route continues along San Martín Avenue and Perú Avenue.

In Valparaíso, you will see [Sotomayor Square](/chile/place/plaza-sotomayor/), ride the [El Peral Funicular](/chile/place/el-peral-funicular/) and walk along [Paseo Yugoslavo](/chile/place/paseo-yugoslavo/), the Yugoslav Promenade named in the itinerary.

After the excursion, we return to Santiago.
